MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Bluetooth adapter feels like a natural next choice because it adds connectivity through a small USB device, much like my earlier WiFi and Ethernet adapters.",
    "Ethernet cables and USB expansion fit my history of connecting devices, and cable ties could help organize those connections, although none creates a clear need to buy now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The hard drive, memory, CPU coolers and SSD bracket assume I am upgrading internal computer parts, while my past choices mostly solved specific connection or accessory needs.",
    "Six short Ethernet cables, a hundred cable ties and a powered ten-port hub exceed the needs I can identify right now. Being useful in principle is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "The flash drive shares USB connectivity with several past purchases, but storing files is a different purpose from adding a connection my device lacks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My computer accessories seem to have been treated as interest in a broad desktop upgrade project.",
    "USB connections and networking terms seem to have mattered more than the specific problem each purchase would solve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My history suggests occasional purchases for particular needs, so I need a clear practical use before another accessory feels worth choosing.",
    "The Bluetooth adapter offers a focused capability, while the larger packs and hub require needs I have not shown.",
    "Internal parts depend on a planned upgrade and compatible hardware, neither of which is established by my previous adapter purchases."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connectivity but stretched it into broader computer upgrades and expansion needs I do not currently have."
}
